design_philosophy: Cinematic scrollytelling. Emotionally directed. Uses close-ups, sweeping landscapes, negative space, and deep earthy colors to create an immersive documentary experience for the Congaree National Park.

headings.h1_classes: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
headings.h2_classes: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight text-white
headings.chapter_marker: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#d4a373] font-sans font-semibold mb-4 block

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32 for sections. 100vh for immersive background sections.
layout.structure: Scrollytelling format. Background images use position: sticky or fixed with full viewport height. Content boxes scroll over the background images.
layout.content_box_style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0b0a]/60 border border-white/10 p-8 md:p-12 rounded-lg max-w-xl shadow-2xl
layout.grid_system: Bento grids for gallery sections if any, but primary flow is single column narrative with asymmetrical text box placements (left aligned on one section, right aligned on next).

motion.animation_library: framer-motion for scroll-triggered fades and parallax.
motion.parallax_effect: Use useScroll and useTransform to move background images slightly slower than content.
motion.entry_animations: Fade in and slight translate-y upward for text boxes as they enter the viewport.

components.hero: Full screen immersive background image, centered title with tracking-tighter, slow subtle zoom-in animation on background.
components.chapter_section: 100vh container. Sticky background. Content div scrolls past. Uses content_box_style.
components.timeline_marker: Vertical line indicator with year/era on the side, sticky while in section.

image_urls.description: Misty swamp forest for atmospheric hero intro
Old growth forest with sunlight filtering through
Cypress trees with knees in water
Fireflies at night representing ancient magic of the land
Vintage or cut trees logging history

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion heavily for scroll-based transitions on text panels.
Ensure background images are high-quality, cover the viewport, and remain stationary (or move slowly via parallax) while text panels scroll over them.
Apply backdrop-blur to text panels to allow the forest imagery to bleed through subtly.
Do not use generic UI cards. Use 'Crystal Glass' style overlays with 1px border for text containers.
Incorporate data-testid attributes for testing interactive elements.
Add dark gradient overlays (e.g., bg-black/40) to hero images to ensure white text contrast.
Do not use generic Inter font. Import Cormorant Garamond and Outfit via Google Fonts.
Make sure images are applied via inline styles with background-image or using next/image with full layout covering the section bounds.
Use standard HTML section elements instead of layout components for the documentary scrolling feel.
